_meta.metric: Scope 1 fuel combustion emission factors (CO2 + CH4 + N2O as CO2e)
_meta.basis: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 GHG conversion factors (flat file v1.1) — combustion factors matched to the 2024 reporting year. natural_gas/diesel/petrol are the DEFRA 2024 per-unit values; the remaining fuels retain IPCC 2006 defaults pending a DEFRA 2024 swap (flagged).
_meta.note: co2e_kg_per_base_unit is the DIRECT (combustion, Scope 1) factor for the listed base_unit — it does NOT include upstream/WTT. ncv_gj_per_base_unit allows unit conversion when the input differs (energy = qty_in_base_unit x ncv). wtt_kg_co2e_per_base_unit is the well-to-tank (upstream) factor per base_unit for Scope 3 Cat 3, from UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 'WTT- fuels' (natural gas per m3, diesel/petrol average-biofuel-blend per litre). Fuels without a WTT value are skipped in Cat 3 with a warning.
_meta.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 GHG conversion factors (flat file v1.1)
